card.line: Spain was a far western land where Paul hoped to travel and preach the gospel, a plan he shared in his letter to the church in Rome.

moments.title: Paul hopes to reach Spain
moments.text: In his letter, Paul writes that he hopes to see the believers in Rome on his way to Spain. The verses do not say he ever got there.

moments.title: Spain after Jerusalem
moments.text: Paul first must take a gift to the poor saints in Jerusalem. After he delivers it safely, he says he will set off to Spain by way of Rome.
